sentence: By contrast, the [birthstone chart’s documented history](/birthstones-by-month/) starts with a 1912 US trade convention; the flower references reviewed identify no equivalent founding meeting for a shared birth-flower chart.

May's own birth-flower page runs into the same kind of unverified backstory from a different angle: [this site's May birth flower page](/may-birth-flower/) checks a French lily-of-the-valley custom and an old hawthorn proverb that both turn out shakier than the florist copy suggests.
